1. Annual Flight Physical and Dental need to be completed by the end of your birth month. Contact Class Advisor for questions.
2. VR Sims are available to students in building 3125.
3. Sim standby to check in with sim supervisor and wait in the sim building lounge until end of scheduled standby period.
4. During weekdays, open OFT or UTD sim lines on the VT-2 flight schedule are available practice sims for VT-2 students. Open sims assigned to VT-
2 will not be hard scheduled or reserved by any squadron. These are to be utilized on a first come, first serve basis for VT-2 students. Any TW-5
Instructor Pilot requiring the use of an open sim takes priority.
5. Marine Student PFT every Wednesday at 0630 USS Intrepid Rd Pull-up bars. Every Thursday Radford Gym NAS Pensacola with MATSG-21. Snivel
as required.
6. In-flight photography (PHOTOEX) is authorized on all IP/IP flights to facilitate the positive promotion of Primary Flight Training and the Naval
Aviation Enterprise, not to interfere or supplant scheduled training, and shall be conducted in a safe, professional, and risk adverse manner IAW
the requirements set forth in TRAWINGFIVEINST 3710.2 and CNATRAINST 3710.38. Squadron PAO review and CO approval is required prior to
posting or distributing any in-flight photographs on social media or other mediums of communication.
7. Students may be scheduled and shall be prepared for 2 flights per day from the FAM4200 block forward, unless specifically prohibited by the
JPPT. For Cross Country Operations, you may expect to be scheduled for 3 flight/sims per day.
8. Students SHALL ensure ALL CAIs are completed prior to the execution of simulator or flight events for which they are a prerequisite.
9. All weekend aircraft MUST be signed for Friday or Saturday. No fuel available after 2000 Saturday at KNSE. No fuel available Sunday at KNSE.
Aircraft issue available Saturday from 0800-1500.
